title: Fathers in Prison: Maintaining Safe Connection
description: This course supports fathers who are currently incarcerated to maintain safe, child-centred connection with their children. It focuses on emotional presence, respectful communication, and understanding the child’s experience during parental imprisonment.
learningOutcomes: Understand how imprisonment affects children emotionally and developmentally.
Learn safe ways to maintain connection through letters, calls, or supervised visits.
Recognise behaviours that support or harm a child’s sense of safety.
Develop skills for emotional presence and respectful communication.

modules.title: Understanding the Child’s Experience
modules.content: Explores how children process parental imprisonment and what they need to feel safe.

modules.title: Maintaining Safe Connection
modules.content: Covers letters, calls, supervised visits, and child-centred communication.

modules.title: Preparing for Reconnection
modules.content: Provides guidance on emotional readiness, accountability, and safe expectations.
